disclaimer: This tool is a cognitive risk screening aid designed for preliminary assessment, NOT a clinical diagnosis. Results should be interpreted by healthcare professionals.
disclaimer_or: ଏହି ଉପକରଣଟି କେବଳ ଏକ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ଜ୍ଞାନଗତ ବିପଦ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ସହାୟକ, କୌଣସି ଡାକ୍ତରୀ ନିଦାନ ନୁହେଁ। (needs native review)

fields.name: Age
fields.label: Age (years)
fields.help_text: Age of the participant in completed years.
fields.help_text_or: ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀଙ୍କ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବର୍ଷରେ ବୟସ। [needs native review]

fields.name: Sex
fields.label: Biological Sex
fields.help_text: Biological sex recorded at birth or official documentation.
fields.help_text_or: ଜନ୍ମ କିମ୍ବା ସରକାରୀ ପରିଚୟପତ୍ରରେ ଥିବା ଲିଙ୍ଗ। [needs native review]

fields.name: EDUC
fields.label: Years of Formal Education
fields.help_text: Total years of formal schooling completed (e.g., 0 for no formal schooling, 10 for matriculation, 15 for degree).
fields.help_text_or: ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହୋଇଥିବା ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ଶିକ୍ଷାର ମୋଟ ବର୍ଷ (ଯଥା: ୦ ନିରକ୍ଷର, ୧୦ ମାଟ୍ରିକ, ୧୫ ସ୍ନାତକ)। [needs native review]

fields.name: SES
fields.label: Socioeconomic Status (1-5)
fields.help_text: Estimated socioeconomic band on a 1-5 scale (optional, automatically imputed if unknown).
fields.help_text_or: ୧ ରୁ ୫ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ରେ ସାମାଜିକ-ଅର୍ଥନୈତିକ ବର୍ଗ (ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ, ଅଜ୍ଞାତ ଥିଲେ ସ୍ୱତଃ ଗଣନା ହେବ)। [needs native review]

fields.name: MMSE
fields.label: MMSE / HMSE Total Score (0-30)
fields.label_or: ଏମ୍.ଏମ୍.ଏସ୍.ଇ / ଏଚ୍.ଏମ୍.ଏସ୍.ଇ ମୋଟ ସ୍କୋର (୦-୩୦) [needs native review]
fields.help_text: Total score from Mini-Mental State Examination or Hindi/Odia Mental State Examination (0-30). Only required for test-assisted screening.
fields.help_text_or: ଜ୍ଞାନଗତ ପରୀକ୍ଷଣର ମୋଟ ସ୍କୋର (୦-୩୦)। କେବଳ ପରୀକ୍ଷା-ଆଧାରିତ ସ୍କ୍ରିନିଂ ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। [needs native review]
